subject: Acme Analytics — Request for BCP/DR evidence and RTO/RPO numbers
messages:
From: Sarah Mendez <sarah.mendez@acme-analytics.com>

Cc: Acme Analytics Security <security@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 16:14:00 -0700
Subject: BCP/DR evidence request for procurement

Hi Marissa,

We're finishing the last stage of our procurement review and our security team has a short set of follow-ups on business continuity and disaster recovery. They asked for the following evidence to complete their assessment: 

- Summary of Redwood's BCP and DR program (high level).
- Last full DR test date and the test report or summary of findings.
- Target RTO and RPO for hosted inference and any differences for Dedicated/Private deployments.
- Backup frequency and retention for model artifacts and customer data (high level).
- Contact for on-call/incident manager during DR events.

Can you share this information (or a pointer to the evidence bundle) by end of week? If some items need redaction, please flag those.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turn.

Sarah
Sarah Mendez
Senior Security Program Manager
Acme Analytics

Subject: Re: BCP/DR evidence request for procurement

Hi Sarah — thanks for outlining this so clearly. I'm looping in Kar (sales) and Grace (SE) plus our security/infra contact to compile the materials.

Quick notes:
- We routinely run tabletop and full failover drills; the last full DR test was in Nov 2025.
- RTO/RPO targets differ by deployment: hosted API has a best-effort cache warmup strategy, Dedicated/Private can be configured to tighter RTOs — I'll confirm exact numbers.
- We'll share a summary PDF, the November test report (redacted where needed), and a CSV with per-service RTO/RPO.

I'll aim to get the package to you by Thu EOD Pacific. If that's too late, let me know.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: BCP/DR evidence request — Acme Analytics (action: DR evidence bundle)

Team — FYI: Acme (prospect) needs our BCP/DR artifacts. Can we assemble the following by Thu: 

1) One-page BCP/DR summary (PDF) suitable for external review.
2) DR test report from Nov 18, 2025 (redact internal IP as needed).
3) RTO/RPO table (CSV) showing targets for: Hosted API, Dedicated, Private (on-prem).
4) Short contact info for incident manager and backup on-call.

David — can you own the summary + test report redactions?
Grace — can you confirm whether any customer-specific RPOs exist for Dedicated contracts we should note?
Kar — please keep Acme's procurement looped and give me any timing constraints.

If anything needs legal review, flag it early.

Thanks — Marissa
From: david_kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: BCP/DR evidence request — Acme Analytics (action: DR evidence bundle)

Marissa / Grace — I've pulled the artifacts and prepped the bundle. See summary below and attached files. I'll redact personnel names and internal CI prior to external delivery.

Attachments included (placeholders):
- redwood_bcp_summary.pdf (overview of program, escalation paths, backups)
- dr_test_report_2025-11-18.pdf (full test report, high-level findings + mitigations)
- rto_rpo_table.csv (service,RTO,RPO rows for Hosted, Dedicated, Private)

Key data points (extract):
- Last full DR test: 2025-11-18 (simulated region failover + cold start recovery).
- Hosted API: RTO target 30 minutes for control-plane failover, best-effort cache warmup for model-serving; RPO depends on cache vs persistent stores, default RPO for persistent metadata is 1 hour.
- Dedicated: RTO target 15-30 minutes (depending on reserved capacity and warm standby options); RPO default 1 hour unless contractual SLAs specify otherwise.
- Private (on-prem): RTO/RPO are customer-configurable; we provide recommended defaults (RTO 1 hour, RPO 4 hours) and migration playbooks.
- Backups: model artifacts are snapshotted and replicated daily with 30-day retention for hosted-managed artifacts; customer-managed storage retention varies per contract.
- Incident contacts: primary on-call (PagerDuty) + escalation list included in summary PDF.

Let me know if you want me to remove any operational detail before we send externally. Happy to provide a branded PDF bundle and a short cover note.

-David
David Kim
Director, Reliability Engineering | Redwood Inference

Highlights:
- Last full DR test: 2025-11-18; report attached with remediation notes.

If your team needs a brief walk-through of the test findings or wants a redline of any specific controls, David is on copy and can join a short call.

Best,
Marissa

Subject: Re: Redwood BCP/DR evidence bundle for Acme Analytics — attached

Thanks Marissa — received and reviewed the attachments. A couple quick clarifications from our security reviewers:

1) Can you confirm whether the 30-minute Hosted API RTO refers to control-plane orchestration only or includes model-serving warm-up time for active sessions?
2) For Dedicated deployments, do you have a published SLA addendum with guaranteed RTO/RPO when customers purchase warm-standby or cross-region replication?

If David can answer 1) and point us to any existing SLA addendum for 2), we should be able to close the BCP/DR portion of the questionnaire. Could we get answers by EOD tomorrow?

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Sarah
